title: Agent Harness
desc: Reliable execution environments for LLMs — context management, tool orchestration, and feedback loops.
descZh: 为 LLM 构建可靠的执行环境：上下文管理、工具编排与反馈闭环。

title: Multi-Agent Systems
desc: Role specialization, task decomposition, and orchestration that make hard problems parallel and verifiable.
descZh: 角色分工、任务分解与协作编排，让复杂问题可并行、可验证。

title: Mathematical Reasoning
desc: Tool-calling workflows with SymPy/NumPy verification loops for trustworthy reasoning.
descZh: 结合 SymPy/NumPy 验证闭环的工具调用工作流，让推理结果可校验。

title: RAG & Knowledge
desc: Domain knowledge bases, hybrid retrieval, and evaluation datasets for grounded generation.
descZh: 领域知识库构建、混合检索与评测数据集，让生成有据可依。
